title: Northgate+ Entry Requirements and Eligibility Re-Verification
content:
Enrollment desk reference for **Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships**: who each tier admits, the minimum age, the proofs of eligibility the tier accepts, and the re-verification and time limits on the discounted tiers.

| Tier | Customer types admitted | Minimum age (whole years on the enrollment date) | Accepted proofs of eligibility | Re-verification every (calendar months) | Maximum cumulative months on the discounted tier | Tier after a missed re-verification |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Rewards | consumer, business | 13 | none | 0 | 0 | not applicable |
| Northgate+ Assist | consumer | 18 | SNAP EBT, Medicaid | 12 | 0 | Northgate+ Monthly |
| Northgate+ Student | consumer | 18 | student enrollment | 12 | 48 | Northgate+ Monthly |
| Northgate+ Monthly | consumer | 18 | none | 0 | 0 | not applicable |
| Northgate+ Annual | consumer | 18 | none | 0 | 0 | not applicable |
| Northgate+ Business | business | 18 | business registration | 0 | 0 | not applicable |

**Definitions**

- *Minimum age*: the minimum whole years of age on the enrollment date, computed from the profile date of birth.
- *Accepted proofs*: the accepted proofs of eligibility for the tier.
- *Re-verification*: the calendar months after the date eligibility was verified at which eligibility must be re-verified; 0 means no re-verification.
- *Maximum cumulative months*: the maximum cumulative months a member may hold the discounted tier; 0 means no limit.
- *Tier after a missed re-verification*: the tier the membership moves to at the next renewal when re-verification is not completed.

**Boundary on both sides (hypothetical birthdays)**

| Customer's whole years of age on the enrollment date | Northgate Rewards | Any Northgate+ tier |
|---|---|---|
| 12 | below the minimum | below the minimum |
| 13 | meets the minimum | below the minimum |
| 18 | meets the minimum | meets the minimum |
